analysis.summary: Accent Microcell Ltd held its earnings conference call on May 16, 2026, to discuss financial and operational results for the half year and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. Management reported strong export growth, driven by higher demand for premium products such as Microcrystalline Cellulose (MCC) spheres and sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), while noting a delay in the commercialization of Unit 3 due to external regulatory approvals and abnormal monsoons. The company highlighted that raw material cost increases for wood pulp are fully passed on to customers and does not foresee significant medium-term demand challenges. Additionally, management discussed capacity expansion plans up to Phase 6 and clarified that trading activities are used temporarily to retain customers until new manufacturing facilities are fully online. Accent Microcell Limited reported its financial results for the year ended March 31, 2026, with revenue from operations reaching ₹34,903.28 Lakhs.
